```{r setup, include=FALSE}

knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

# load libraries
library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggpubr)

```

## Load Data

Load barcode count matrix
```{r load_data}

ec_data = read.csv("ec_manuscript_data.csv", row.names = 1)


```

Load HBMAP results
```{r mcmc_unique}

mcmc_unique_EC8 = readRDS("ec_hbmap_results.rds")

```

Extract Motif Allocations, and add to barcode count matrix as new column.
```{r}

EC8_Z_reordered = mcmc_unique_EC8$Z

ec_data$allocation = unlist(EC8_Z_reordered)

```

## Define Function

```{r}

motif_summary_charts = function(ec_data, df2, chart_clusters){
  
  # define targets
  nc_targets = c("PFC", "ORB", "MO", "SS", "ACA", "PTL", "VIS", "RSC")
  
  # reformat df2
  df2 <- do.call(rbind, df2)
  df2$region <- factor(df2$region,
                     levels = nc_targets)
  
  LEC_proportion_overall <- nrow(ec_data[ec_data$EC == "LEC", ])/nrow(ec_data)
  MEC_proportion_overall <- 1-LEC_proportion_overall
  
  # Proportion of LEC and MEC
  motif_proportion <- lapply(chart_clusters,
                               function(j){
                                 
                                 motif_data =  ec_data %>% filter(allocation == j)
                                 motif_data_lec = motif_data %>% filter(EC == "LEC")
                                 LEC_proportion = nrow(motif_data_lec)/nrow(motif_data)


                                 MEC_proportion <- 1-LEC_proportion

                                 data.frame(cluster = j,
                                            EC = c('LEC','MEC'),
                                            proportion = c(LEC_proportion, MEC_proportion))
                                 
                               })

  motif_proportion <- do.call(rbind, motif_proportion)
  
  # For each cluster
  plot1 <- lapply(chart_clusters,
                function(j){

                  df2 %>%
                    filter(cluster == paste('cluster', j)) %>%
                    ggplot(mapping = aes(x = region,
                                         y = mean_projection_strength,
                                         group = 1))+
                    geom_line()+
                    geom_errorbar(mapping = aes(ymin = lower_projection_strength,
                                                ymax = upper_projection_strength),
                                  width = 0.1)+
                    geom_point()+
                    theme_bw()+
                    ylab('projection probability')+
                    theme(axis.line = element_line(colour = "black"),
                          panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
                          panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
                          panel.border = element_blank(),
                          panel.background = element_blank(),
                          axis.text = element_text(size = 10,
                                                   color = 'black')
                          )+
                    scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(0,1), limits = c(0,1))
                })
  
  plot2 <- lapply(chart_clusters,
                function(j){

                  motif_proportion %>%
                    filter(cluster == j) %>%
                    ggplot(aes(x = factor(cluster, levels = chart_clusters),
                               y = proportion,
                               fill = EC))+
                    geom_bar(stat = 'identity')+
                    theme_bw()+
                    xlab('')+
                    ylab('')+
                    scale_fill_manual(values=c(LEC = '#16697A', MEC = '#DB6400'))+
                    geom_hline(yintercept=MEC_proportion_overall, linetype="solid",
                               color = "red",
                               linewidth = 1.5)+
                    coord_flip()+
                    ggtitle(paste0(nrow(ec_data[ec_data$allocation == j, ]), ' neurons, ',
                              nrow(ec_data[ec_data$allocation == j & ec_data$EC == "LEC", ]), ' LEC, ',
                              nrow(ec_data[ec_data$allocation == j & ec_data$EC == "MEC", ]), ' MEC')) +
                    
                    theme(legend.title=element_blank())+
                    theme(legend.position="none")+
                    xlab('')+
                    scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(0,1))+
                    theme(axis.line = element_line(colour = "black"),
                          panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
                          panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
                          panel.border = element_blank(),
                          panel.background = element_blank(),
                          plot.title = element_text(size=12))+
                    theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 12))

                })
  
  plot_all <- lapply(1:3, function(i) ggarrange(plot2[[i]], plot1[[i]], nrow = 2, heights = c(0.45,1)))

  return(plot_all)
  
  
}



```


## Generate Figure


```{r}

nc_targets = c("PFC","ORB", "MO", "SS", "ACA", "PTL", "VIS", "RSC")

chart_clusters_3c = c(33, 64, 25)

df2_3c = lapply(chart_clusters_3c,
              function(j){

                data.frame(cluster = paste('cluster', j),
                           region = nc_targets,
                           mean_projection_strength = mcmc_unique_EC8$proj_prob_med[j,],
                           lower_projection_strength = mcmc_unique_EC8$proj_prob_lower[j,],
                           upper_projection_strength = mcmc_unique_EC8$proj_prob_upper[j,])
              })

motif_summary_charts(ec_data, df2_3c, chart_clusters_3c)

```
